notes.title: Truck Mechanic Playtest is Live!
notes.content: [p][b]We're excited to announce that the playtest for Truck Mechanic has started![/b][/p][p]Some time ago, we opened the playtest participation form and received numerous applications — thank you all for your interest and support! In the meantime, we've been hard at work improving the game: polishing existing mechanics, enhancing various aspects, plus constantly adding new content and exciting features. We truly hope you'll enjoy the experience![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/9ec8151f3b38e8704f86d28ea7ea7b5548cbf1b5.png"][/img] Many of those who applied have already been granted access — check your notifications, as you might be eligible to try the game right now![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/9ec8151f3b38e8704f86d28ea7ea7b5548cbf1b5.png"][/img] Everyone who gets access to the playtest will also see a “Grant Playtest Access to a Friend” button in their library. Don’t forget to share it with someone who’d love to join too![/p][p]We'll continue granting access gradually, in waves, so keep an eye on your Steam notifications to see if you've been selected.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/39264ff82d0c15f3838cdb30cca75b9f7c37f451.png"][/img] During the playtest, you'll be able to explore the entire first map (Jungle) with all its locations and points of interest. However, the main storyline and a number of side quests will be limited to avoid major spoilers. Go wherever you like, tinker with repairs, discover peculiar locales, and maybe even stumble upon a few surprises. And once you're done exploring, exit the map and head back to the garage to try out the novel truck customization options that you've unlocked![/p][p]We're extremely grateful to everyone joining the playtest — especially those who take a moment to share their feedback using [url="https://forms.gle/DQjvcfGD9NDY3DUT9"]this survey[/url] (you can also find a button linking to it in-game).[/p][p]Your thoughts and impressions are incredibly valuable and will help us better the game and smooth out any rough edges before the full release. The project's already in the final stretch leading up to the launch, but we'd love to hear from you and find out if there's anything else we can improve to make the adventure as fun and comfortable as possible.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/ed9e0d82f19ee8ec80f59cf2fc3c7e70564bad3b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]JOIN OUR COMMUNITY[/b][/p][p]We also invite you to join our [url="https://discord.gg/GEV2MrdMzy"]Discord community[/url], where you can actively share feedback, chat with other players awaiting the release, and ask any questions you might have. We'd be happy to see you there![/p][p]Thank you and happy testing![/p]

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths — Dev Diary #97
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, Truck Mechanics![/b][/h1]

It's been a while since we last got in touch, but now we're back with a massive update for Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths, and trust us – it's been worth the wait! We've packed in a ton of new features, interactions, and systems to keep you busy on the perilous roads... Let's dive right in!

[previewyoutube=phI9LPvF1gY;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b]New Interactions[/b]

We've significantly expanded the range of uses and interactions for your tools. You can now open and repair gates and signs, or even demolish blockades using your trusty machete. You can also pick up new objects such as cash, skill books that grant free skill unlocks, and customization items. Additionally, the bolt cutters are now useful for slicing through certain fences, while the winch can be used to break down terrain obstacles. And that's not all – keep an eye out for paint buckets scattered around in-game locales to alter your truck's color scheme and give it a fresh new look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/ce1dd50ad883d88f2b69907d44f0e6fb25c62c6b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b] New Reputation System [/b]

With so many new interactions, we've also revamped the reputation system. To progress through certain missions, you'll now need to attain specific reputation levels. And how do you do that? By completing side quests, cargo deliveries, and smaller tasks that earn you reputation points. It's time to step up and prove your worth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/f110099cf8d0fd40e42dd3f3fc50a4135fc3a15d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b] Skill System [/b]

Finally, the long-awaited skill system is here! We've introduced 4 distinct skill categories: Driving, Mechanics, Exploration, and Economy. Each skill can be purchased with the cash you've collected or, as mentioned earlier, by finding special skill books hidden throughout the world. Unlock them to gain a strategic edge and further tailor your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/16d9af3a8504fe235c5804270d98d353c9cdbf0f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b]Misc Changes[/b]

In addition to these major inclusions, we've revised the tutorial system to make it clearer and more informative, ensuring that every newcomer knows the ropes. We've also introduced a guidebook where you can revisit essential mechanics or view gameplay tips at any time. Not to mention, the game now has full controller support, updated UI, and numerous other quality-of-life improvements to make your journey smoother than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/26dc916097af06ce7d277c4191faa68e5dbc4ae1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

notes.title: Start Your Adventure!
notes.content:

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths — Dev Diary #96
notes.content:
Hello, Truck Mechanics!

It’s time to unveil some exciting updates we’ve been working on to make your journey through Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths even more immersive, rewarding, and adventurous.
[previewyoutube=d5NmMbm5KE8;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b]Reputation System [/b]

Let’s start with something cool—the Reputation System. The more you contribute to the world through missions and challenges, the more of its doors will open for you. Higher reputation doesn’t just earn you respect but comes with tangible benefits. Think better deals on essentials like fuel, exclusive customization options to make your truck truly stand out, and access to additional quests packed with unique opportunities. Reputation is tied to individual maps, meaning that your standing in one region won’t automatically carry over to another—just like in real life, you’ll need to prove yourself wherever you go. This system is designed to reward exploration and dedication, so keep pushing those boundaries to reap the rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/b54a4c53ddb29002ec4254b7d42c112ca254af4e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b]New Tools[/b]

Next, let’s talk tools—because what’s a mechanic without the right gear? We’re introducing new mechanics and upgraded tools to expand how you can interact with the environment. The soldering iron is a game changer, letting you repair electrical systems to access previously unreachable locations. Meanwhile, the bolt cutter has been revamped to open up even more locked areas, paving the way for unexpected adventures. And since no trek down dangerous paths is without its share of grime, your truck will now get visibly dirty as you tackle the toughest of terrain... Don’t worry, it’s all part of the experience! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/00ec52d52386fc06e88b418f134755a922a641aa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b] Updated Points of Interest [/b]

Lastly, the maps themselves are evolving. We’re continuously expanding them with new locales and fresh points of interest, breathing life into every corner of the in-game world. Whether you’re stumbling upon an impressive vista or investigating a hidden nook with something special to uncover, these areas are designed to keep exploration exciting and rewarding. We’re also fine-tuning existing locations, ensuring that every detail meets our vision for quality and immersion. This ongoing process ascertains that no matter how many times you revisit a map, there’s always something new to do or see.

notes.content:
Hello, Truck Mechanics!

It’s time for another development update, and we’re not slowing down: your feedback, combined with our own ambitions, keeps driving the project forward, as we work to make Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths even better. 
[previewyoutube=OK4ppUvmCJY;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b] NPCs[/b]

One of the biggest changes you’ll notice is the addition of NPCs across all maps. They will breathe life into the game’s world, with some being tied to quests and others serving to make the environment feel more alive. You’ll be able to interact with all of them, though don’t expect to find everyone in a chatty mood: some might be too busy or appear less than friendly, but each person you meet is going to have a logical in-universe role to play. This layer of interaction and detail is designed to deepen the immersion and make exploration feel more rewarding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/865343309832e4b1d6c4749c922ee31b620fc51d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

Another key addition is improved lighting, especially when it comes to nighttime navigation. Lamps have been installed around every map, providing a realistic glow that not only enhances the atmosphere but also makes it easier to spot objects and find your way in the dark. Whether you’re crossing a narrow bridge or maneuvering through dense foliage, these beacons will be there to guide you while maintaining the game’s rugged realism.

We’ve also added new objects and environmental details, making each locale distinct and visually engaging. Exits and key paths are now better marked to help with navigation without sacrificing the overall sense of adventure. Beyond these highlights, we’ve also revisited areas that needed a touch-up, fixing issues and enhancing textures to meet our ever-rising quality standards.

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths — Dev Diary #94
notes.content:
Hello, Truck Mechanics!

We've got exciting updates to share and think you're going to love them! Our goal is to keep the game's world full of things to do, discover, and earn, so that you always feel like there's something new just around the corner. So, let's jump in and see what's in store!

[previewyoutube=WkDBeiODomc;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're looking for easy money, they'll definitely be worth your while!

[h1]The Prologue is here, Mechanics! 🔥🧑‍🔧[/h1]

After many months of hard work, the day has finally come - [b]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue[/b] is now available for you to play ːsteamhappyː

[b]What is a FREE prologue?[/b]
Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue is a glimpse into the universe of an upcoming simulation game, showcasing the basic mechanics and a story introduction to the full game. 

[previewyoutube=jWu2IBT0tt0;full][/previewyoutube]

We are extremely happy that we delivered the prologue on time. Thanks for all the suggestions and tons of solid feedback from playtests. Remember you are taking an active part in the production. So please share some more ideas, more juicy feedback and suggestions for change - we're open. We feel like dropping everything and playing a bit more of our work, but unfortunately the full version will not make itself.

And this means only one thing - that the game will be changed and in the end it will be much.

[h2]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue Features:[/h2]

[b]Interesting storyline[/b]
– When creating Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue, our goal was not only to develop a solid gameplay with interesting game mechanics, but also an engaging story. Therefore, in addition to tinkering with the truck, you will learn what dangers you may encounter in the wilderness.

[b]Perform minor truck repairs on the road[/b]
– Imagine a situation where your car has broken down. Normally you call for roadside assistance and the problem is solved. But what if your truck broke down in the middle of nowhere? We give you the chance to test yourself in such a scenario. With a well-equipped toolbox you should be able to deal with all obstacles. Whether it's a flat tire or a broken engine.

[b]Garage serving as a hub for personalization [/b]
– The garage is a place where you will have the ability to customize the look of your truck to your own preference. Steering wheels, seats, gear knobs, and rims are just waiting to be pimped. The more tasks you complete, the more cash you will have for these sweet upgrades! Ride with swag!

[b]Side missions not only concerning the truck[/b]
– In addition to performing complex truck repairs, there will be those unrelated to the truck. All this is to encourage you to explore, and to show you that the whole world doesn't circle around your vehicle after all. As an experienced mechanic, you will have to step out of your comfort zone and try something new.

[b]Possibility to drive on the most difficult routes in the world[/b]
– The South American wilderness can be a real pain. Even for the most experienced drivers, so be ready for any scenario. Make thoughtful decisions and remember - there are many paths to your destination.

[b]The prologue is FREE! We wish you a wide road and successful repairs :)[/b]
